gatePolicyNotes.every-step: You approve every assignment before it starts.
gatePolicyNotes.lead-asks: A step starts without approval unless the lead asks you. Steps wait until the lead has finished its turn so it can ask first.
gatePolicyNotes.none: Assignments start without approval. Budget uncertainty and agent tool approvals still reach you.

acknowledgementText: Score controls the work it starts (turns and steps) and can stop those runs; agents may still use other tools and start background work Score can't see or stop.
